import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int mx, mn, k;
        if (n > 0) {
            mx = sc.nextInt();
            mn = mx;
            for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
                int x = sc.nextInt();
                if (x > mx) mx = x;
                if (x < mn) mn = x;
            }
        } else {
            mx = 2000;
            mn = 2200;
        }
        k = (mx - mn) / 2;
        System.out.println(mx - k);
        sc.close();
    }
}
